verdict.rationale: Manufact ships an official MCP server that exposes platform management (servers, deployments, logs, observability) as MCP tools, usable from Cursor, Claude, or any other MCP client, with one-click installs/copy-paste config and a dedicated setup flow documented and probed live. missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of the official server working end-to-end (community evidence is sparse/mixed on general MCP usage, not this specific server) and no detail on authentication/versioning robustness beyond changelog notes.
